SANJIV BERRY, J. (ORAL)

Status report dated 12.07.2024 in the form of an affidavit of Deputy Superintendent of Police, Sirsa,
District Sirsa, has been filed.
The same is taken on record.
Copy thereof has been supplied to learned counsel for the petitioner.

2. By way of present petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C, the petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR (Annexure P-8) as under: -
FIR No. Dated Sections Police Station 133 03.04.2024 420, 467, 468, Civil Lines, Sirsa.
 471 IPC 3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in compliance to the order dated 30.05.2024, the petitioner has joined the investigation.

4. During the course of hearing on 30.05.2024, following order had been passed: -

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner, inter alia, contends that earlier the University informed that the record of the petitioner was not found but later they have claimed that the petitioner was not enrolled.

He submits that the certificates submitted by the petitioner are genuine and during the course of the pendency of anticipatory bail before the learned Sessions Judge, Sirsa, the petitioner was on interim bail and has joined the investigation.
3. Notice of motion.
4.

On the asking of the Court, Mr. Surender Singh, AAG, Haryana, present in Court,
accepts notice on behalf of the State-respondent and prays for time to file the status report/reply in the matter.
5.
Adjourned to 15.07.2024.

6. Needful be done well before the date fixed with an advance copy to the counsel opposite.
7.

In the meanwhile, the petitioner is hereby directed to join investigation within seven days from today and in the event of his arrest, he is ordered to be released on interim bail on his furnishing personal/surety bonds to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Officer.
He shall also abide by conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C."

5. Learned State counsel on instructions from ASI Rajpal informs the Court that the petitioner has joined the investigation and is neither required for further investigation nor for any custodial interrogation.

6. Keeping in view the above submissions made by learned State counsel and the fact that the petitioner had joined the investigation consequent to the order dated 30.05.2024 passed by this Court, interim bail granted vide order dated 30.05.2024 is hereby confirmed, subject to 2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:087625 conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
Further the petitioner is directed to join investigation as and when required in future by way of written notice for such purpose to be served by Investigating Officer of this case upon the petitioner;
he will not tamper with the evidence nor will influence the witnesses and will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
7.
The petition stands allowed.
8. It is made clear that anything contained hereinabove shall not be construed to be an expression of opinion on the merits of the case.
